respec_accacc.name: Accomplished Accomplice*
respec_accacc.description: Once per encounter per Droid Companion, when an allied character within short range of a Droid Companion would fail a check, spend a Destiny Point to add [BO] equal to that Droid Companion’s ranks in that skill to the check.

respec_agaodd.name: Against The Odds*
respec_agaodd.description: Add [BO] per ranks of Against the Odds to Daunting or harder checks.

respec_alwaprep.name: Always Prepared
respec_alwaprep.description: Once per session, as an incidental, produce a previously undocumented piece of personal equipment or weapon, with a rarity no greater than 4, as if a Destiny Point was spent. If producing a weapon, it also has the Limited Ammo 1 quality.

respec_asqula.name: Ask Questions Later
respec_asqula.description: Once per encounter as an out-of-turn incidental, before the character or an ally makes a social check, add [AD], [SU], or [TR] to that check, determined by the strongest type of adversary defeated during the current encounter: [AD] for a minion, [SU] for a rival, [TR] for a nemesis.

respec_assasimp.name: Assassinate (Improved)
respec_assasimp.description:
Before rolling a combat check while undetected by the target, suffer strain up to [BO] in pool to trade that many [BO] for that many [AD]. Assassinate may remove a Rival by spending [AD][AD][AD] or [TR].
Assassinate may affect Nemesis foes at Game Master discretion.

respec_assassin.name: Assassinate
respec_assassin.description: When inflicting a critical injury on a minion group, if undetected by them, may spend additional [AD] to remove an additional member per [AD] spent. A character is considered to be undetected by a foe if they aren’t aware of their general or specific location, and aren’t on alert to their presence, before the attack. A Game Master may determine that even when generally alerted, a character is still undetected until they either attack again or reveal themself visually.

respec_astobsimp.name: Astute Observation (Improved)
respec_astobsimp.description: Once per session, if an ally would fail a check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to roll a Perception check using the original difficulty, if successful, the ally's check succeeds with the same results as the Perception check.

respec_astuobse.name: Astute Observation
respec_astuobse.description: Once per encounter, may add [BO] equal to ranks in Astute Observation to an ally’s check.

respec_authsubj.name: Authority On The Subject
respec_authsubj.description: Once per encounter when a foe would make a check, may spend 1 Destiny Point to establish a fact and treat the check as opposed by the character’s most appropriate Knowledge Skill.

respec_badmotimp.name: Bad Motivator (Improved)
respec_badmotimp.description: Once per session when taking the Bad Motivator action, the character may choose a trigger or circumstance under which the device will fail, rather than it failing immediately. The device functions normally until that trigger occurs.

respec_barghunt.name: Bargain Hunter
respec_barghunt.description: When the character makes a check to purchase or sell goods or services, they add [BO] or remove [SE] equal to their ranks of Bargain Hunter.

respec_binally.name: Binary Companions*
respec_binally.description: The Character may choose an additional willing PC or NPC droid as an additional Droid Companion per rank of Binary Companions. The character may choose different skills to add [AD] to for each Droid Companion.

respec_bloolust.name: Bloodlust
respec_bloolust.description: After incapacitating or inflicting a Critical Injury on a foe, add [BO] per rank of Bloodlust to the next check the character makes this encounter.

respec_bocoan.name: Boring Conversation Anyway
respec_bocoan.description: Once per session, may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a failed social check to immediately make an attack against the target of that social check as an incidental.

respec_bolster.name: Bolster
respec_bolster.description: As a maneuver, the character may remove [SE] per rank of Bolster imposed by a single environmental circumstance from all actions they make this encounter. This may be used multiple times to remove setbacks imposed by additional environmental circumstances.

respec_bolstimp.name: Bolster (Improved)
respec_bolstimp.description: The benefits of the Bolster maneuver apply to all allies within short range as long as they remain within short range of the character.

respec_bypsecimp.name: Bypass Security (Improved)*
respec_bypsecimp.description: May spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from checks to unlock doors or disable a security device to add [BO] equal to ranks of Bypass Security to similar checks in the same system or location this session.

respec_captaudi.name: Captive Audience
respec_captaudi.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm or Deception check to captivate a group of people with a performance. On [SU], add [FA] to checks made by audience for the duration of the performance. May spend [TR] to add [FA][FA] instead.

respec_cargdrop.name: Cargo Drop
respec_cargdrop.description: Once per encounter, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check to dump the ship’s cargo. Foes within short range equal to [SU] must drop to speed 1 or suffer a major collision. The character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to trigger any additional effects, based on the nature of the cargo dropped, and Game Master determination.

respec_comp.name: Compelling Counterpart*
respec_comp.description: Choose one social skill per Droid Companion. While engaged with Droid Companion, add [AD] to checks using the chosen skill.

respec_condimp.name: Conditioned (Improved)
respec_condimp.description: Once per session while falling, spend a Destiny point to reduce range bands fallen by ranks of Conditioned, to a minimum of Short. This affects the effective damage and strain suffered from the fall, not the fall distance itself.

respec_dazzflou.name: Dazzling Flourish
respec_dazzflou.description: May spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a successful melee attack to upgrade the ability of each ally’s next attack targeting that enemy.  May spend [TR] from a failed melee attack for the same effect.

respec_decoy.name: Decoy*
respec_decoy.description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to produce a facsimile of an encumbrance 1 or smaller item in the scene. Any character attempting to determine that it is counterfeit must make an opposed Perception vs. Skulduggery check.

respec_delaresp.name: Delayed Response
respec_delaresp.description: Once per session after being detected or discovered, may spend 1 Destiny Point to delay alarm, pursuit or reprisal until the end of the character's next turn.

respec_despscra.name: Desperate Scramble
respec_despscra.description: Once per session, make a  Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coordination check to escape confinement through a previously unknown method. On success, the character is able to escape and may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to allow allies to follow. The nature of the escape method is Game Master discretion, but may be highly improbable.

respec_direc.name: Directive*
respec_direc.description: Once per round as a maneuver, suffer strain no more than ranks in Directive. Upgrade the ability of the next check made by an allied droid within short range a number of times equal to strain suffered.

respec_dirttric.name: Dirty Tricks
respec_dirttric.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check to add [SE] equal to [SU] to the next check made by a number of enemies equal to the character’s ranks of Cunning.

respec_disruptiveimp.name: Disruptive (Improved)
respec_disruptiveimp.description: Spend [AD][AD] from a Computers check or [TH][TH] when opposing a foe's computers check to add [FA] equal to the character's ranks of Disruptive to a foe's next Computers check in that system.

respec_drocom.name: Droid Companion*
respec_drocom.description: Choose a willing PC or NPC droid as a Droid Companion. Choose two skills. The Droid Companion adds automatic [AD] to checks using those skills. These skills may be changed with a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check and six hours of reprogramming. If the droid is lost or destroyed, the character may apply Droid Companion to a new droid. The process of modifying and acclimating to the new droid is at the GM's discretion. No two characters may have the same Droid Companion.

respec_drsord.name: Doctor's Orders*
respec_drsord.description: When recovering under your supervision, characters heal an additional wound whenever they passively heal wounds, and add [SU] to any check to heal their critical injuries.

respec_dynamicper.name: Dynamic Personality
respec_dynamicper.description: Once per encounter after making a successful social check, suffer strain up to the character's Presence to increase or decrease an affected character's defense by that number until the end of the next round. This cannot increase a character's defenses above 4.

respec_emerbypa.name: Emergency Bypass
respec_emerbypa.description: Once per encounter, when an engaged starship or vehicle suffers a critical hit, spend a Destiny Point and have the engaged starship or vehicle suffer system strain equal to the severity of that critical hit to choose a different critical hit of the same severity.

respec_enersiph.name: Energy Siphon
respec_enersiph.description: Once per encounter, make an Opposed Athletics vs Athletics check against an engaged foe to drain the energy from an equipped, powered item and recover strain equal to total encumbrance of drained item(s). Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to drain an additional equipped item. Items drained cease functioning until either recharged or reloaded.

respec_exitstra.name: Exit Strategy*
respec_exitstra.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Vigilance check to notice a discreet path of egress. On success, add [BO] to all checks the character or allies with medium range make to leave the encounter. This includes attacks against characters who intentionally impede their escape.

respec_explosivesurprise.name: Explosive Surprise
respec_explosivesurprise.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check to establish how a previously existing device or explosive the character possesses has been covertly placed somewhere within long range of them. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to allow the character to make an Easy ([DI]) Mechanics check as an incidental to activate or detonate the device while they are within extreme range of it. How the device was hidden is at the Game Master's discretion.

respec_exptraimp.name: Expert Tracker (Improved)
respec_exptraimp.description: Once per session, the character may make the Improved Expert Tracker action; Make a Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Survival or Perception to find a minor item lost by a tracked target. Decrease the Difficulty once per rank of Expert Tracker. On a successful check, spend [TR] to find a Major item instead. An example of a minor item is like an identifying accessory or some material indicating previous location or mode of travel. Examples of Major items could be an item like a sentimental or “quest item” that the target may not want to leave the vicinity without recovering, or an item like a weapon that may inhibit their combat effectiveness due to having lost.

respec_eyeostor.name: Eye of the Storm
respec_eyeostor.description: Perform the Eye of the Storm maneuver, suffer 1 strain, to make next Brawl attack this turn gain the Blast quality with a rating equal to ranks of Brawn plus ranks of Discipline. Blast triggered on this attack only affects foes.

respec_fadeaway.name: Fade Away*
respec_fadeaway.description: Once per encounter, when targeted by a combat check, spend a Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to the character's ranks in Stealth. If that attack fails, the character may not be targeted by attacks until the beginning of their next turn.

respec_fearimp.name: Fearsome (Improved)
respec_fearimp.description: May Spend [AD][AD] from Coercion checks or [TH][TH] from foes’ Discipline check to have the target suffer strain equal to ranks of Fearsome.

respec_fearjump.name: Fearless Jump
respec_fearjump.description: Once per session, may reroll a Astrogation check to make a hyperspace jump, and add [TR] [DE] to the result. [DE] added this way cannot be canceled by effects of talents, abilities, or equipment.

respec_fintunimp.name: Fine Tuning (Improved)
respec_fintunimp.description: Once per encounter while engaged with or repairing a starship or vehicle, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check to increase the system strain threshold of an the vessel by a number equal to the character's ranks in Fine Tuning for the rest of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover System Strain equal to ranks in Fine Tuning.

respec_fituimp.name: Fine Tuning (Improved)*
respec_fituimp.description: Once per encounter while engaged with or repairing a starship or vehicle, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check to increase the system strain threshold of an the vessel by a number equal to the character's ranks in Fine Tuning for the rest of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover System Strain equal to ranks in Fine Tuning.

respec_flycasual.name: Fly Casual
respec_flycasual.description: Once per encounter while piloting, spend a Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to Cunning to a check made to identify, scan, or investigate the craft or its contents.

respec_followmylead.name: Follow My Lead
respec_followmylead.description: Once per round, spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from a check to allow an ally within short range count as having the same number of ranks of that skill as the character for the next check they make using that skill.

respec_forcexpl.name: Forceful Expulsion
respec_forcexpl.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computerscheck to eject another character accessing a connected system. Spend [AD][AD] from this check or on a successful Eject User check to inflict strain equal to ranks of Knowledge (Education), and spend [TR] to render the chosen character's slicer's gear or access point unusable.

respec_frlow.name: Friends in Low Places
respec_frlow.description: Add [AD] per rank of Friends In Low Places to check the character makes to find or interact with the criminal element.

respec_fromshad.name: From the Shadows
respec_fromshad.description: While undetected by enemies, the character may use the Stealth Skill when making checks to determine initiative.

respec_ghosmach.name: Ghost in the Machine
respec_ghosmach.description: Suffer strain up to ranks in Stealth to add an equal number of [SE] or remove an equal number of [BO] from checks to trace, locate, or identify the character while they are slicing, including physical discovery.

respec_glidstep.name: Gliding Step
respec_glidstep.description: Add [BO] to melee attacks for each move maneuver performed this round.

respec_grepalimp.name: Greased Palms (Improved)
respec_grepalimp.description: Once per session, may reroll a social check by paying credits equal to 100 times the difficulty of the check.

respec_handoff.name: Hand Off*
respec_handoff.description: Once per round, as an out-of-turn incidental, suffer 2 strain to covertly pick up or hide an engaged item that is encumbrance 1 or smaller, or exchange up to two items that are encumbrance 1 or smaller with an ally within short range. If the character is being closely watched, an opposed Perception vs. Skulduggery check can be made to notice the exchange, adding [SE][SE] to the pool.

respec_haphelimp.name: Happy to Help (Imp)*
respec_haphelimp.description: Once per encounter, when assisting or being assisted, may choose to have Happy To Help add [SU] to the check instead of [BO].

respec_happhelp.name: Happy to Help*
respec_happhelp.description: When providing or accepting assistance, add [BO] to the check in addition to the normal effects of assistance.

respec_healself.name: Heal Thyself*
respec_healself.description: When performing a check to heal themselves, may substitute Resilience instead of the required skill to avoid increasing the difficulty of the check.  This includes Mechanics checks to heal cyborgs or droids, but does not apply to Resilience checks to passively heal critical injuries. Talents that affect Medicine checks still apply to this roll.

respec_hidfea.name: Hidden Feature*
respec_hidfea.description: Once per session as an incidental, while the character is aboard a vessel they created or are intimately familiar with, they may activate a previously unknown minor feature of the vessel as if a Destiny Point had been spent, per GM discretion. This feature lasts until the end of the encounter. At any future point, any character may reactivate this feature by spending a Destiny point.

respec_hirehelp.name: Hired Help
respec_hirehelp.description: Once per Encounter, the character may take the Hired Help action; they make an opposed Negotiation vs Discipline check targeting a minion group or Rival within Medium range. On success, they work towards the character's goals until the end of the encounter. The character must pay a minion group whose services are bought this way 100 credits per minion in the group, or 500 credits for a Rival. The task they are directed to perform must not violate common sense, their core values, or be obviously suicidal. The Game Master ultimately has control of the NPC(s), and determines the bounds of their support.

respec_hirhelimp.name: Hired Help (Improved)
respec_hirhelimp.description: Once per encounter, may spend 1 Destiny Point to have engaged Hired Help take a successful hit on the character instead, or take responsibility for something the character did.

respec_hirhelsup.name: Hired Help (Supreme)
respec_hirhelsup.description: The Hired Help action may now target enemy Minions and Rivals. The credit price to target them is doubled.

respec_histimp.name: Historian (Improved)
respec_histimp.description: Once per session when interacting with ancient or abandoned places or things, may spend 1 Destiny Point to cancel a [DE] or [TH] equal to ranks of Historian from a check the character or an ally makes.

respec_historian.name: Historian
respec_historian.description: When recalling information about or interacting with ancient or abandoned places or things, add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Historian.

respec_hitthedeckimp.name: Hit The Deck (Improved)
respec_hitthedeckimp.description: When activating Hit The Deck, allies within short range of the character equal to Cool or Vigilance may also perform a Move maneuver as an incidental to move into cover out of a blast radius of a weapon or explosion.

respec_hotswap.name: Hot Swap
respec_hotswap.description: After changing weapons, add [BO] per rank of Hot Swap to the next attack made with weapons not yet used in this encounter.

respec_huntimp.name: Hunter (Improved)
respec_huntimp.description: After the character inflicts a critical injury on or incapacitates a foe with an attack, or otherwise causes a critical injury or incapacitation of a foe, the character may perform a maneuver as an incidental. This does not allow the character to perform more than 2 maneuvers per turn, but may allow them to make maneuvers out-of-turn.

respec_huntsup.name: Hunter (Supreme)
respec_huntsup.description: Before making a combat check against a non-sentient creature as a maneuver, suffer strain up to the target’s silhouette to reduce that attack's critical rating by the same amount, to a minimum of 1.

respec_impdetimp.name: Improvised Detonation (Improved)
respec_impdetimp.description: Reduce the difficulty of Improvised Detonation to Average ([DI][DI]) and increase damage to twice ranks in Mechanics.

respec_impdetsup.name: Improvised Detonation (Supreme)
respec_impdetsup.description: When taking the Improvised Detonation action, may add Burn +1, Concussive +1, Ensnare +1, Ion, Knockdown, Pierce +2, Stun +2, and/or Stun Damage qualities to the explosive, upgrading the difficulty of the check once for each quality chosen. Any number of qualities may be chosen, but each ranked option may only be chosen three times.

respec_impdirec.name: Improved Directive*
respec_impdirec.description: Once per encounter when performing the Directive maneuver, may affect an additional allied droid per rank of Directive, and the range of Directive increases to medium.

respec_impsurg.name: Surgeon (Improved)*
respec_impsurg.description: When performing a Medicine check, may suffer strain up to ranks of Surgeon, then choose to either remove that many [SE] or add that many [BO].

respec_itsabarg.name: It's a Bargain
respec_itsabarg.description: When buying goods, may have the item become damaged 1 step to reduce the price by 20%. Whether an item can be used while damaged is at Game Master discretion.

respec_itsastea.name: It's A Steal
respec_itsastea.description: When selling damaged or misrepresented goods, may make an opposed Deception vs. Vigilance check, and treat their value as if they were undamaged and genuine. Add [SE] for each step of damage the item has, and upgrade the difficulty of the check if the item is not genuine.

respec_jaoatr.name: Jack of All Trades
respec_jaoatr.description: When making a skill check using a skill with fewer ranks than their ranks of Jack Of All Trades, suffer a number of strain up to the difference to upgrade the ability of the check that many times.

respec_juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
respec_juggernaut.description: When the character suffers a critical injury, spend a Destiny Point to reduce the Critical Injury result by 10 per rank of Resilience, to a minimum of 1.

respec_juline.name: Just Like New*
respec_juline.description: Spend a Destiny Point to treat a non-destroyed piece of equipment within medium range as if it isn’t damaged until the end of the character's next turn.

respec_keeeyeimp.name: Keen Eyed (Improved)
respec_keeeyeimp.description: Once per session, make a  Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception or Vigilance check to add [SU] to next checks they and allies make to act on the observation. Decrease difficulty of check once per rank of Keen Eyed.

respec_kilkinimp.name: Kill With Kindness (Improved)*
respec_kilkinimp.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm or Leadership check. On success, a number of characters equal to the character's ranks of Kill With Kindness add [AD] or [TH] to checks they make this encounter, chosen separately for each character. Spend [TR] to double the number of [AD] or [TH] added this way.

respec_killconfirmed.name: Kill Confirmed
respec_killconfirmed.description: Once per session, upgrade the difficulty of the next ranged attack the character makes once to have one hit of that attack ignore the target's soak. The Game Master may spend [TH][TH] or [DE] to have the weapon run out of ammo or otherwise malfunction.

respec_killerinstinct.name: Killer Instinct
respec_killerinstinct.description: Unarmed and improvised weapons attacks the character makes gain a Pierce equal to their ranks in Survival.

respec_kilorkill.name: Kill Or Be Killed
respec_kilorkill.description: Once per session when exceeding wound threshold, spend a Destiny Point to make a melee attack. If the target dies, wounds become equal to ranks of Resilience below threshold instead.

respec_knowacti.name: Knowledge In Action
respec_knowacti.description: When making a skill check involving technology, tools, or mechanisms, the character may spend a Destiny Point to substitute a Knowledge skill, per Game Master discretion, instead of the required skill.

respec_knowprey.name: Know Your Prey
respec_knowprey.description: Once per encounter make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check to add [SE][SE] to all checks that target or are opposed by the character for the remainder of this encounter. Spend [AD] to extend that benefit to one ally per [AD] spent, and [TR] to upgrade the difficulty of those checks once.

respec_landprov.name: The Land Provides
respec_landprov.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check to fashion a low-tech solution to a current problem using nearby forageable materials. This solution or object must be approved by the GM, who may impose negative qualities like Inferior or Limited Ammo, and functions until the end of the encounter.

respec_lighmood.name: Lighten the Mood
respec_lighmood.description: When recovering at the end of an encounter, may roll Average ([DI][DI]) Charm check. On Success, allies equal to Presence add [SU] to their recovery rolls. The character may spend [AD][AD] to have an affected ally add an additional [SU] to their check, and may spend [TR] to recover the same number of strain as one affected ally.

respec_logibomb.name: Logic Bomb
respec_logibomb.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers Check and choose a connected system or device the character has access to, and a triggering event. On success, when the event occurs, the character may immediately enact a single command of their choice to that system or have it shut down, chosen at the time of triggering.

respec_macmanimp.name: More Machine Than Man (Improved)
respec_macmanimp.description: Before making a check, suffer strain up to half of the the number of character's installed cybernetics, rounded up, and add that many [BO] to the check. The player must specify how one or more of their cybernetics are aiding them for this check.

respec_macmenimp.name: Machine Mender (Improved)
respec_macmenimp.description: When making a check to repair a droid, the character may spend [AD][AD] a number of times up to rank of Machine Mender to increase any combination the droid’s melee or ranged defense once per [AD][AD] spent until the end of the session, and may spend [TR] to increase its Soak by 1.

respec_makdanimp.name: Make It Dangerous (Improved)
respec_makdanimp.description: Suffer 1 strain to decrease the difficulty of Make it Dangerous to Average ([DI][DI]). Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] so that all critical injuries inflicted by an attack using this weapon result in a Crippled effect, unless the roll would result in a more grievous injury. This effect lasts until Make It Dangerous expires.

respec_makidoor.name: Making A Door
respec_makidoor.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check to treat an explosive as if it had the Breach 1 quality when breaching a specific structure or vehicle this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to treat it as if it had Breach 2 instead.

respec_makitint.name: Let’s Make It Interesting*
respec_makitint.description: Once per session after making a successful check to wager or gamble, spend a Destiny Point to have a loser substitute or supplement a narrative or material reward of the character's choice, instead of only credits. The reward is per GM discretion.

respec_makluck.name: Make Your Own Luck*
respec_makluck.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool Check. On success, allies equal to ranks of Cool may reroll 1 positive die on the next check they make, plus one additional die for every [SU][SU] past the first. Spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to allow one of those allies to reroll positive or negative instead.

respec_maodl.name: Master of Dealing
respec_maodl.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce the difficulty of next check to find, buy, or sell stolen, contraband or illegal goods once.

respec_marconimp.name: Market Connections (Improved)
respec_marconimp.description: The character may use Market Connections to locate a seller of an illegal good by substituting Knowledge (Society) instead of the required skill and upgrading the difficulty of the check once.

respec_marconsup.name: Market Connections (Supreme)
respec_marconsup.description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from Market Connections action to have the seller include a related item with a value and rarity no greater than half that of the original item, rounded down, at no additional cost. The item include is at Game Master discretion.

respec_martprow.name: Martial Prowess
respec_martprow.description: When making a combat check, may suffer 2 strain to substitute Athletics for Melee, or Coordination for Ranged (Light or Heavy).

respec_masarmimp.name: Master of Arms (Improved)
respec_masarmimp.description: Once per encounter, when using the Master of Arms action, spend [AD][AD] or a [TR] to immediately take an additional action.

respec_masarmsup.name: Master of Arms (Supreme)
respec_masarmsup.description: When making the Master of Arms action, the character may choose any number of additional weapons to increase an existing quality’s rating of each of those weapons by 2, and may choose a different quality for each affected weapon. If they do, upgrade the difficulty once for each chosen weapon beyond the first. Each of the chosen qualities cost one less [AD] to activate, to a minimum of 1.  Qualities that do not have a rating, such as Auto-Fire, are not applicable for the reduction.

respec_mastmani.name: Master Manipulator
respec_mastmani.description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to perform a social check as a maneuver.

respec_mastnone.name: Master of None
respec_mastnone.description: Once per round, add [SU] to a skill check the character makes using a skill that the they have less than 2 ranks in.

respec_mercshot.name: Merciful Shot
respec_mercshot.description: Before making a non-Gunnery ranged attack, may suffer 2 strain to inflict damage as strain instead of wounds. If using a weapon with the Stun Damage quality or using the Stun Setting, add [BO][BO].

respec_mershoimp.name: Merciful Shot (Improved)
respec_mershoimp.description: When inflicting damage from non-gunnery ranged attack as strain damage, may spend  [AD] [AD] [AD] or [TR] to Stagger or Immobilize the target.

respec_mustspec.name: Mustafar Special
respec_mustspec.description: Once per round, may make an opposed Piloting vs Piloting check against starship or vehicle within close range. On Success, that craft suffers system strain equal to ranks in Cunning plus [SU]. Spend [AD][AD] to affect an additional craft within close range.

respec_natucamo.name: Natural Camouflage
respec_natucamo.description: When making a stealth check in natural environments, suffer two strain to substitute Survival for the required skill.

respec_natureme.name: Natural Remedy
respec_natureme.description: The character may use Survival instead of Medicine to heal wounds and critical injuries by increasing the difficulty of the check once.

effects.condition: to heal wounds and critical injuries

respec_noissafe.name: Nowhere is Safe
respec_noissafe.description: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from a non-vehicle or starship attack to reduce the target’s defense by a number equal to ranks in Perception until the end of the character’s next turn

respec_nosafimp.name: Nowhere is Safe (Improved)
respec_nosafimp.description: After making a successful attack against a defenseless target, may suffer 3 strain to add [TR] to the check. A character is considered defenseless if they have no defense rating against the attack.

respec_notimebleed.name: No Time To Bleed
respec_notimebleed.description: Once per session, as a maneuver, spend a Destiny Point to recover strain and/or wounds in any combination up to ranks in Discipline.

respec_nowitnes.name: No Witnesses
respec_nowitnes.description: Once per encounter, after incapacitating an enemy, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Stealth check. On success, they are undetected as the attacker. May spend [AD] to move one range band per [AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to escape the scene completely.

respec_oddjob.name: Odd-Job
respec_oddjob.description: Once per session, after successfully negotiating to purchase goods or services, the character may offer to perform a task or favor in lieu of payment. If this task is not performed before the end of the session, they take Obligation equal to the original difficulty of the check to purchase, or based on credit cost, or other narrative factors, per Game Master discretion.

respec_onlook.name: On The Lookout
respec_onlook.description: When making a check to determine initiative, spend a Destiny point to add [SU] to both their check and to a number of allies' equal to ranks in Cunning.

respec_opp.name: Opportunist
respec_opp.description: The character adds a [BO] per rank of Opportunist to combat checks made against enemies who have attacked an ally this round, or are otherwise distracted, per GM discretion.

respec_orelse.name: …Or Else
respec_orelse.description: Once per session, after the character or an ally within Short range makes a Coercion check that fails or results in [DE] spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] to the result.

respec_overkill.name: Overkill
respec_overkill.description: Once per attack when the character causes a foe to exceed their wound threshold, suffer 2 strain to assign a hit dealing damage equal to the amount exceeding that threshold to another target within short range of the first.

respec_pathsuncharted.name: Paths Uncharted
respec_pathsuncharted.description: Once per session, make a Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation check to find an uncharted hyperspace route. On success, the route is either immediately ready for the character jump as an incidental, untraceable and unrepeatable by anyone but the character, or the shortest possible in both distance and time. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to pick additional effects.

respec_perbodimp.name: Personal Body Guard (Improved)
respec_perbodimp.description: Once per session when performing the Body Guard Maneuver, may spend 1 Destiny point to have all attacks targeting the guarded character target the user instead until the user's next  turn. Upgrade each attack targeting the character equal to the strain suffered performing the  Body Guard maneuver.

respec_permai.name: Percussive Maintenance*
respec_permai.description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, before making a check to repair or damage an engaged machine, starship, vehicle, or droid, suffer 2 wounds to add [BO] equal to the character's ranks of Melee or Brawl (whichever is higher) to the check.

respec_persbody.name: Personal Body Guard
respec_persbody.description: Once per encounter before an attack is made targeting an ally within short range, may move to their position and perform the Body Guard Maneuver as an out of turn incidental.

respec_preaimimp.name: Precise Aim (Improved)
respec_preaimimp.description: When using Precise Aim, all non-Gunnery attacks made by the character this round have their Pierce rating increased by ranks in Precise Aim.

respec_precon.name: Diagnostician
respec_precon.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check. On success, the character (or player) details an observation they've made of a character within short range that reveals a medical condition they are suffering from. This condition may be purely narrative in nature and effect, but the Game Master may choose to impose negative effects on the diagnosed character.

respec_prepturb.name: Prepare for Turbulence
respec_prepturb.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation check. On success, the character notices or navigates towards a moderate navigation hazard at close range. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] for a severe navigation hazard.

respec_pullstri.name: Pulling Strings
respec_pullstri.description: Once per Session, make an opposed Social check to compel the target to perform a minor favor this session. Add [TR] to one check associated with this favor.

respec_quicpick.name: Quick Pickup
respec_quicpick.description: Once per encounter while piloting a starship or vehicle, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting check to have any number of allies within medium range of the craft board it as an out-of-turn incidental.

respec_raisstak.name: Raise The Stakes*
respec_raisstak.description: Once per check, the character may suffer 2 strain to increase and upgrade the difficulty of their next check once. If successful, add [AD] equal to the final difficulty of the check to the results.

respec_raistaimp.name: Raise The Stakes, Improved*
respec_raistaimp.description: Double the number of [TR] and [DE] results on checks affected by Raise The Stakes, regardless of Success.

respec_readwind.name: Read The Wind
respec_readwind.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check. On success, a moderate ([SE][SE]) environmental effect appears. Spend [TR] for a severe ([SE][SE][SE]) environmental effect. This hazard could be weather, man-made actions, or natural disasters.

respec_reawinimp.name: Read the Wind (Improved)
respec_reawinimp.description: May suffer 2 strain to perform the Read The Wind action as a maneuver.

respec_reforsky.name: Reach For the Sky
respec_reforsky.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion or Leadership check. A number of characters equal to Willpower suffer 1 strain when they perform a maneuver this encounter. Spend [TR] to force a character to perform a move maneuver.

respec_revfor.name: Reversal of Fortunes*
respec_revfor.description: Once per session, after the character makes a check resulting in [DE],  spend 1 Destiny Point to cancel a [DE] result and add a [DE] to the next check made by an adversary in the scene. How the character turned their misfortune around is per GM discretion.

respec_sawcomin.name: Saw it Coming
respec_sawcomin.description: Once per encounter; make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check to add [TH][TH] to all attacks made against the character or allies within short range until their next turn. Spend [TR] to add [FA] to those attacks.

respec_sendmess.name: Sending a Message
respec_sendmess.description: Once per encounter, after incapacitating a foe or inflicting a critical injury, suffer 3 strain to add [TH] to all checks made this encounter by foes within Medium range equal to Willpower.

respec_shadsecr.name: Shadowfeed Secret
respec_shadsecr.description: Once per session, may choose target location or faction, or person and make a Knowledge (Underworld) check with a difficulty based on the target. On [SU], may add [TR] to a Computers check to slice that target this session.

respec_shfr.name: Shoot First
respec_shfr.description: Once per session when a foe would attack, spend a Destiny Point to make a Ranged (Light) attack against that foe before they act as an out-of-turn incidental. They are considered to have not yet acted this round.

respec_sidedipl.name: Sidearm Diplomacy
respec_sidedipl.description: Once per encounter, may add a number of [SU] equal to ranks in Sidearm Diplomacy to a social check, and upgrade the difficulty of that check once.

respec_signsupe.name: Signature Superiority
respec_signsupe.description: Once per encounter while aboard the Signature Vehicle, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check.  On [SU], the character and a number of allies equal to the character’s Intellect add [SU] to all checks involving the signature Vehicle until the end of the character's next turn.

respec_sigvehimp.name: Signature Vehicle (Improved)
respec_sigvehimp.description: The character’s Signature Vehicle may have a silhouette or 5 or less. Increase the character’s Signature Vehicle's top speed by 1, to a maximum of speed 6.

respec_skilorat.name: Skilled Orator
respec_skilorat.description: Once per round, may spend [TR] from a social check to affect twice the number of targets, or have each target recover or suffer twice the number of strain.

respec_smoooper.name: Smooth Operator
respec_smoooper.description: After making a successful Gunnery attack, spend a Destiny Point and suffer strain no greater than [SU] to convert that many [SU] to [AD].

respec_somereal.name: Something More Real
respec_somereal.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point when negotiating the cost of goods or services to introduce physical goods to be bartered, counting the value of those goods at 125% of their current value, instead of or in addition to credits. Modify the check based on legality and the item's level of damage.

respec_soreimp.name: Solid Repairs (Improved)
respec_soreimp.description: Once per encounter, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check to increase the armor of an engaged starship or vehicle by 1 until the end of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover hull trauma equal to the character's ranks of Solid Repairs.

respec_souinvimp.name: Sound Investments (Improved)
respec_souinvimp.description: At the beginning of each session, may invest all Sound Investment credits and make a Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Core Worlds) or Knowledge (Underworld) check, decreased by ranks of Sound Investments, to gain a return on the investment. On [SU], gain 100 additional credits plus 10% of the initial investments for each [SU] past the first. On [FA], lose half of the initial investment. [TR] may be spent to double the number of successes on a successful check, or recover 75% of initial investment on a failed check.

respec_specmodi.name: Special Modifications
respec_specmodi.description: Once per session, may make an Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check to temporarily convert an attachment currently installed on equipment or a vehicle into another valid attachment with equal or lesser hard points and rarity. They may make this permanent by spending 6 hours and spending credits equal to the new attachment's cost minus the cost of the original attachment.

respec_spitimp.name: Guns Blazing (Improved)
respec_spitimp.description: Once per round after making a successful two-weapon Ranged (Light) attack, suffer 3 strain to assign an additional hit from either weapon to a target within range.

respec_stakeimp.name: Stakeout (Improved)
respec_stakeimp.description: When using the Stakeout action, may spend [AD] to extend this benefit to 1 ally per [AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to add [SU] to 1 ally's checks.

respec_stakeout.name: Stakeout
respec_stakeout.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool or Skulduggery check while surveilling a person or place.  For the remainder of the session, add automatic [AD][AD] to checks they make that are associated with that location or person.

respec_stenerimp.name: Steady Nerves (Improved)
respec_stenerimp.description: Once per encounter when performing a check involving a precise and/or dangerous technical action, may suffer strain up to ranks of Steady Nerves to downgrade the difficulty of the check that many times.

respec_sterstuf.name: Sterner Stuff
respec_sterstuf.description: Once per session, when the character would exceed their strain threshold, they may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check to reduce their strain to 1 below the strain threshold instead.

respec_strfleimp.name: Stronger Than Flesh (Improved)
respec_strfleimp.description: Stronger Than Flesh may also be used to avoid crits of [DI][DI][DI] or [DI][DI][DI][DI] severity.

respec_strofles.name: Stronger Than Flesh
respec_strofles.description: Once per encounter, may avoid suffering a [DI] or [DI][DI]  severity critical injury by having an installed cybernetic immediately malfunction. It provides no benefit until the character spends several hours making an Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check to repair it.

respec_supdirec.name: Supreme Directive*
respec_supdirec.description: Once per session, choose a skill and make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check. On success, a number of allied droids within medium range up to ranks of Directive may treat their ranks of that skill as equal the character’s ranks until end of character’s next turn. Spend [TR] to extend this effect 1 round.

respec_supfirimp.name: Suppressing Fire (Improved)
respec_supfirimp.description: Foes who suffer strain from the effects of the character’s Suppressing Fire and foes within short range of the targeted character upgrade the difficulty of their next check once.

respec_swind.name: Swindler*
respec_swind.description: Add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Swindler from checks to cheat or commit subterfuge. Applicable checks are per GM discretion.

respec_taracqimp.name: Target Acquired (Improved)
respec_taracqimp.description: When taking the Target Acquired Action, the character adds [BO] per status effect affecting the target. Spend [TR] generated on the check to Stagger an affected adversary. Disorient, Burn, Prone, Immobilized, Staggered, and suffering from Crippling Blow are all status effects, but this list is not exhaustive, and GMs should include other non-named effects.

respec_targacqu.name: Target Acquired
respec_targacqu.description: Take the Target Acquired Action, make an opposed Coercion check against an adversary within Medium Range. On Success, immobilize that adversary until the end of the next round. Spend [AD][AD] to effect an additional foe within medium range. When spending [AD] to affect additional targets, the additional targets must be of an equal or lesser adversary tier.

respec_thanmak.name: Thank The Maker!
respec_thanmak.description: Once per session per Droid Companion, when a Droid Companion would be incapacitated or destroyed, spend a Destiny Point. It is not defeated until the end of the character’s next turn. If the droid is mechanically stabilized before the effect ends, it is not incapacitated or destroyed.

respec_tinkimp.name: Tinkerer (Improved)
respec_tinkimp.description: Once per session as an incidental, spend a Destiny Point. For each item benefiting from the character's Tinkerer, add [AD] equal to the character's ranks in Tinkerer to the next check using it.

respec_trsh.name: Trick Shot
respec_trsh.description: The character removes [SE][SE] imposed on Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) checks due to their target's cover or from the aim maneuver. Additionally, the character may make Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks targeting foes for which they lack line of site, per GM discretion.

respec_ultimatum.name: Ultimatum
respec_ultimatum.description: Once per encounter, may make an opposed Negotiations vs. Cool check to add [SU] to each check made to attack or subdue the target. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to affect an additional target.

respec_uneaansw.name: Unearth the Answer
respec_uneaansw.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Lore) check to reveal that an item or place conceals a hidden secret that solves a problem in the current scene.

respec_unlopote.name: Unlocked Potential
respec_unlopote.description: Once per session, the character or an ally within short range may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a check using a modded vehicle or piece of equipment to temporarily install a uninstalled Mod of an installed attachment of that item or vehicle until the end of the session (including a previously failed mod option). Additional [TR] may be spent from this or a subsequent check using the weapon or vehicle this session, paying normal modding costs, to unlock it permanently.

respec_unquauth.name: Unquestioned Authority
respec_unquauth.description: Remove [SE] from Coercion and Leadership checks equal to ranks of Unquestioned Authority.

respec_voirea.name: Voice of Reason*
respec_voirea.description: Once per encounter when making Leadership or Negotiation skill check, the character may use a Knowledge skill instead. Check uses Presence and player must explain how, in this particular instance, their Knowledge skill is persuading others or driving the conversation.

respec_watcstep.name: Watch Your Step
respec_watcstep.description:
Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Athletics check to have all other characters within short range suffer 1 wounds plus 1 wound per each [SU]. Spend [AD] to exclude an ally from this effect per each [AD] spent. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to Immobilize one affected enemy for one round. 
The nature of this triggered trap or hazards should be setting-appropriate, such as an ancient platform finally buckling under old age and fresh foot traffic. The character can either cause the trap or hazard to happen or may merely be reacting to it triggering.

respec_wellconn.name: Well-Connected
respec_wellconn.description: Once per Session, the character may reveal a contact who can provide access to a person, location, or resource. When the character does this, they must explain how they know this contact and what their connection is to the desired person, location, or resource. They should be open to helping the players, but the Game Master determines their potential cost, in credits, material, labor, informal promises of future favors, or formal Obligation.

respec_whereithurts.name: Where It Hurts
respec_whereithurts.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check and choose a foe within long range. On success, the character's attack gains Pierce equal to Cunning against that target until the end of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to immediately take another action.

respec_wrethive.name: Wretched Hive
respec_wrethive.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation or Knowledge (Underworld) check to identify the path to the nearest Shadowport. Upgrade all checks to travel to and interact with the Shadowport this session.
